AEtherize.text: Return all attacking creatures to their owner's hand.

An Offer You Can't Refuse.text: Counter target noncreature spell; its controller creates two Treasures.

Arcane Denial.text: Counter target spell; its controller draws two next upkeep, you draw one.

Archaeomancer.text: On enter: return target instant/sorcery card from your graveyard to hand.

Blink of an Eye.text: Kicker {1}{U}. Return target nonland permanent to hand; kicked: draw a card.

Blue Sun's Zenith.text: Target player draws X. Shuffle ~ into its owner's library.

Brainstorm.text: Draw three cards, then put two from your hand on top of your library.

Capsize.text: Buyback {3} (pay extra: return ~ to hand as it resolves). Return target permanent to owner's hand.

Chart a Course.text: Draw two; discard one unless you attacked this turn.

Consider.text: Look at top card; may mill it. Draw a card.

Curiosity.text: Enchanted creature deals damage to an opponent: you may draw a card.

Curse of the Swine.text: Exile X target creatures; each controller creates a 2/2 green Boar per creature exiled this way.

Distant Melody.text: Choose a creature type: draw a card per creature you control of that type.

Dive Down.text: Target creature you control gets +0/+3 and hexproof until end of turn.

Docent of Perfection.text: Flying. Whenever you cast an instant/sorcery: create a 1/1 Human Wizard; then if you control 3+ Wizards, transform ~ (Final Iteration 5/5: Wizards +2/+1 and flying — track via set/note).

Engulf the Shore.text: Return to hand each creature with toughness <= number of Islands you control.

Evacuation.text: Return all creatures to their owners' hands.

Exclude.text: Counter target creature spell; draw a card.

Fact or Fiction.text: Reveal top five; an opponent splits them into two piles; one pile to hand, other to graveyard.

Favorable Winds.text: Creatures you control with flying get +1/+1.

Frantic Search.text: Draw two, discard two, untap up to three lands.

Gravitational Shift.text: Flying creatures get +2/+0; creatures without flying get -2/-0.

Halimar Depths.text: Enters tapped. On enter: look at top three of your library, rearrange. {T}: Add {U}.

Impulse.text: Look at top four; one to hand, rest on bottom.

Into the Roil.text: Kicker {1}{U}. Return target nonland permanent to hand; kicked: draw a card.

Laboratory Maniac.text: If you would draw a card while your library is empty, you win the game instead (claim it).

Lazotep Plating.text: Amass 1 (create/grow an Army token). You and permanents you control gain hexproof until end of turn.

Mana Leak.text: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {3}.

Memory Lapse.text: Counter target spell; put it on top of its owner's library.

Metallurgic Summonings.text: Whenever you cast an instant/sorcery: create an X/X Construct, X = its mana value. {3}{U}{U},Exile ~: return all instants/sorceries from your graveyard to hand.

Murmuring Mystic.text: Whenever you cast an instant/sorcery: create a 1/1 blue Bird Illusion with flying.

Mystic Retrieval.text: Return target instant/sorcery from your graveyard to hand. Flashback {2}{R}... (treat as {2}{U} here).

Mystic Sanctuary.text: Island. Enters tapped unless you control 3+ other Islands. On enter untapped: may put an instant/sorcery card from your graveyard on top of your library. {T}: Add {U}.

Nadir Kraken.text: Whenever you draw a card, you may pay {1}: +1/+1 counter on ~ and create a 1/1 Tentacle.

Peel from Reality.text: Return a creature you control and a creature you don't control to owners' hands.

Ponder.text: Look at top three, rearrange (or shuffle); draw a card.

Pongify.text: Destroy target creature; controller creates a 3/3 Ape.

Pull from Tomorrow.text: Draw X, then discard a card.

Rapid Hybridization.text: Destroy target creature (can't be regenerated); its controller creates a 3/3 green Frog Lizard.

Rewind.text: Counter target spell; untap up to four lands.

River's Rebuke.text: Return all nonland permanents target player controls to their owner's hand.

Rogue's Passage.text: {T}: Add {C}. {4},{T}: target creature unblockable this turn.

Sapphire Medallion.text: Blue spells you cast cost {1} less.

Shark Typhoon.text: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell: create a flying X/X Shark, X = its mana value. Cycling {X}{1}{U}: draw + create an X/X Shark.

Snap.text: Return target creature to hand; untap up to two lands.

Swan Song.text: Counter target enchantment/instant/sorcery; its controller creates a 2/2 blue Bird with flying.

Talrand's Invocation.text: Create two 2/2 blue Drake tokens with flying.

Talrand, Sky Summoner.text: Flying. Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell: create a 2/2 blue Drake token with flying.

Thassa's Oracle.text: On enter: X = your devotion to blue. Look at top X, put up to one on top, rest on bottom. If X >= cards in your library, YOU WIN THE GAME (claim it).

Treasure Cruise.text: Delve (exile graveyard cards to pay generic costs). Draw three.

Unsummon.text: Return target creature to its owner's hand.

Vapor Snag.text: Return target creature to owner's hand; its controller loses 1 life.

Windfall.text: Each player discards hand, draws cards equal to largest number discarded.
